summary.text: A guest token lets a Gu Master without Huang Jin bloodline enter Eighty-Eight True Yang Building. Each entry requires one.

claims.text: When Sun Shi Han urges punishment of Wolf King Chang Shan Yin, Hei Lou Lan refuses. Chang Shan Yin does not have the Huang Jin bloodline, and without a guest token he cannot enter True Yang Building.

Fang Yuan is not a descendant of Giant Sun Immortal Venerable and does not have that bloodline. Even when Eighty-Eight True Yang Building takes form completely, he cannot enter unless Hei Lou Lan gets him a guest token. He expects Hei Lou Lan will need outside help like him sooner or later.
He still has no Huang Jin bloodline, so entering the building still requires Hei Lou Lan’s guest token.

Hei Lou Lan holds two guest tokens, rewards from the twelfth and forty-sixth rounds of True Yang Building. He hands Fang Yuan an ancient token and names it the guest token. Fang Yuan has no Huang Jin bloodline and is an outsider in the building’s perspective, so each entry requires one. The token shines in Fang Yuan’s hand as he follows Hei Lou Lan through the door.
Once Fang Yuan is inside, the guest token in his hand turns into a puddle of cold molten iron and runs between his fingers. Each guest token can be used only once.
Requesting outside help requires guest tokens. Outsiders who want to enter the tower must pay a high price to purchase Hei tribe’s guest tokens.

Outsiders can enter only by using a guest token. It is a one time expenditure item, obtained only on occasion when a round is gotten through. By that point only seven guest tokens have been obtained, and each fetches an astronomical price, which still does not deter expert Gu Masters who lack Giant Sun’s bloodline.

Pan Ping and Chang Biao have no Giant Sun bloodline and enter on guest tokens. Those tokens are precious, so they spend many resources each time they enter. With a guest token they can leave with a thought, and they have already entered and exited many times.

For a person without Giant Sun bloodline, entering Eighty-Eight True Yang Building on a guest token incurs huge expenses. That is why such outsiders treasure the chance and, if they can, will not leave unless they have no other choice.
